[Technology and innovation](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1811)

###### Viruses versus bacteria: PhageLife's proposal for the swine sector from EAFIT

On a pig farm, a bacterial infection can jeopardize the animals' health and the farm's productivity. Furthermore, the problem becomes more complex when the bacteria stop responding to the antibiotics that previously combated them. To explore another approach, the company [PhageLife](https://phagelife.co/) is developing customized solutions using bacteriophages, naturally occurring viruses capable of eliminating specific bacteria.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestra-comunidad-de-talento-nuestro-impacto/virus-contra-bacterias-la-propuesta-para-el "Read more")

[Art and culture](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1826)

###### Educating, connecting and circulating: the challenges of the university in the cultural and creative ecosystem

How can universities contribute to the development of the cultural and creative ecosystem beyond classroom education? This question permeated the academic meeting _"The University in the Cultural and Creative Ecosystem in Medellín and Bogotá_ ," held this Thursday, October 22, at EAFIT and organized in conjunction with the University of Rosario.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/lo-que-esta-pasando/formar-conectar-y-circular-los-desafios-de-la-universidad-en-el "Read more")

[Institutional](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1846)

###### These 16 EAFIT alumni are among the 100 leaders with the best reputation in the country, according to Merco Leaders 2026

Sixteen EAFIT alumni are among the 100 most reputable leaders in Colombia, according to the Merco Leaders 2026 results, published on October 21. The ranking, which recognizes leading figures from various business and social sectors in the country, once again places Juan Carlos Mora Uribe, president of Bancolombia, at the top of the national list.
